title: Banana - Green: modeled ₹509/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Kondotty
summary: January 2022: reported banana - Green prices at Kayamkulam and Kondotty imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹509 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 180 same-variety market pairs screened for banana - Green in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kondotty report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Kondotty (Kerala) both reported banana - Green prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹3,200 per quintal. Kondotty reported a median ₹4,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹900 per quintal, and Kondotty was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 272 km by road
scenes.caption: 272 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹469 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹253 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kondotty report, the rule selects 25 of 25 modeled shipping days. 25 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹509 per quintal (₹287 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kayamkulam to Kondotty was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹50,900, or ₹28,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to banana - Green
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kayamkulam to Kondotty was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹50,900, or ₹28,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Banana - Green: modeled ₹881/qtl left, Kottakkal → Ernakulam
summary: December 2022: reported banana - Green prices at Kottakkal and Ernakulam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 27 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹881 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 292 same-variety market pairs screened for banana - Green in December 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ernakulam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2022
scenes.caption: Kottakkal (Kerala) and Ernakulam (Kerala) both reported banana - Green prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 27 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kottakkal reported a median ₹3,100 per quintal. Ernakulam reported a median ₹4,300 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,200/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,200 per quintal, and Ernakulam was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 144 km by road
scenes.caption: 144 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹31/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹781 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹557 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ernakulam report, the rule selects 27 of 27 modeled shipping days. 27 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹881 per quintal (₹652 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kottakkal to Ernakulam was positive on 100% of matched days in December 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹88,100, or ₹65,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
